answer: The shale escrow is released only against a jetty receipt, and the tundra audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 9 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 55 aliases means carrying 240 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 7 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
